source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 4, 10. Ἵνα μὴ δόξωσιν αἱ γυναῖκες δι' ὠμότητα βεβρωκέναι τὰ τέκνα, οἰκτίρμονας μὲν εἶναί φησιν· τῇ δὲ τῆς ἐνδείας ἀνάγκῃ προσάπτει τὸ πάθος. τὸ δὲ ἦψαν τὸ ἀνάψαι καὶ ὀπτῆσαι δηλοῖ, ὃ δὴ γέγονεν ἐπὶ τῆς Ῥωμαίων πολιορκίας· διὸ καὶ σύντριμμα καλεῖ τὴν παν- τελῆ τοῦ ἔθνους ἀπώλειαν. καὶ ἐν τῇ δευτέρᾳ δὲ τῶν Θρήνων στοιχειώσει τοῦ παρόντος μέμνηται πάθους. καὶ τοῦτο δὲ καὶ τἃλλα πάθη μετ' ἀκριβείας Ἰώσηππος ἐν τοῖς περὶ ἁλώσεως παρέδωκεν.
pass_a_gloss: Lest the women seem to have eaten the children through savagery, he says they are compassionate; and he attaches the passion to the necessity of lack. And “they kindled” shows the kindling and roasting, which indeed came about upon the Romans’ siege; for which reason he also calls the complete destruction of the nation a syntrimma / shatter. And in the second alphabetic sequence of the Laments he also remembers the present passion. And this and the other passions Josephus has handed down with precision in the things about the capture.
pass_b_english: Lest the women seem to have eaten the children through savagery, he says they are compassionate; and he attaches the passion to the necessity of lack. And “they kindled” (Lamentations 4:10) shows the kindling and roasting, which indeed came about upon the Romans’ siege; for which reason he also calls the complete destruction of the nation a shatter. And in the second alphabetic sequence of the Laments he also remembers the present passion. And this and the other passions Josephus has handed down with precision in the things about the capture (Lamentations 2:20).

choices.why: Symmachus/Theodotion gloss Origen cites at Lam 4:7.
